definitions.gloss: shudder; shiver; trembling with fear or horror
definitions.explanation: An involuntary physical trembling caused by intense fear, horror, or shock. Used for situations that inspire deep dread.

examples.japanese: {戦慄|せんりつ}が{走|はし}った。
その{光景|こうけい}に{戦慄|せんりつ}を{覚|おぼ}えた。
examples.english: I felt a shudder at the sight.

examples.japanese: {事件|じけん}の{真相|しんそう}を{知|し}って、{背筋|せすじ}に{戦慄|せんりつ}が{走|はし}った。
examples.english: When I learned the truth of the incident, a shiver ran down my spine.

notes:
USAGE:
{戦慄|せんりつ} is a literary and dramatic word. In everyday speech, people are more likely to say {身震|みぶる}いする (to shudder) or ぞっとする (to be horrified). {戦慄|せんりつ} appears frequently in news, literature, and dramatic contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {戦慄|せんりつ}が{走|はし}る (a shudder runs through one)
- {戦慄|せんりつ}を{覚|おぼ}える (to feel a shudder)
- {戦慄|せんりつ}する (to shudder, to tremble)
- {戦慄|せんりつ}すべき (horrifying, shudder-inducing)

NOTE:
Do not confuse with the homophone {旋律|せんりつ} (melody).
